entries.status: No EU-level schedule or class. EU legislation does not establish classes of narcotic or psychotropic substances; Member States classify drugs according to the 1961, 1971 and 1988 UN Conventions. The Framework Decision on illicit drug trafficking defines 'drug' as any substance covered by the 1961 Single Convention (as amended by the 1972 Protocol) or by the 1971 Convention, or listed in its Annex.

entries.note: No exception is printed in art. 234. The site's UN layer records that the INCB Yellow List says it is not under international control. As extracted, RACEMETORFAN's chemical name reads '( (+)-3-metoxi-N-metilmorfinán)'. Other racemates also show '(+)' (RACEMORAMIDA, RACEMORFAN, NORACIMETADOL), which may be a '±' lost in extraction; the printed page should be checked. Whether the isomers clause brings dextromethorphan under art. 234 is not settled by the text read.
